messages:
Maya Patel: Quick check — can we try shifting the weekly triage from Fri 11am to Thu 9am PT for the next 3 weeks? fewer overlap with infra deploys and should catch more EU folks.
Devon Lee: thumbs up to trying it. Thu 9am works for me most weeks. :+1:
Samir Khan: Thu 9am PT ok from my side. Will need to move my 9:30 recurring 1:1 tho.
Kevin O'Neill: I prefer earlier in the day, Thu 9am is better than Fri 11. Are we keeping it 30m or 20m?
Maya Patel: thinking 20m focused: backlog quick-scan (5m), bug triage (10m), owner assignment + blockers (5m). I've pasted a compact agenda: 
```
20m triage agenda (pilot):
- 0-5m: backlog highlights (owner or triage lead)
- 5-15m: high-priority bug queue (2-3 items)
- 15-20m: owner ping + next actions
```
Devon Lee: Love the compact agenda. Can we add a rolling owner list so we don't overload the same folks? maybe 1-week rotation.
Samir Khan: +1 to rotation. I'll take week 1 (this Thu) if nobody objects.
Kevin O'Neill: I can take week 2. Also suggest we auto-post the bug list before the call — triage-bot can post top 5 P1/P2s at T-30m?
triage-bot: scheduled post set for T-30m to #eng-triage: top 5 bugs pulled from backlog label:bug,sort:priority.
Maya Patel: perfect. Samir — can you add your name to the calendar event as 'triage owner' and drop a 1-line note in the event with owners for next 3 rotations?
Samir Khan: done — added myself for Thu, Kevin for next week, Devon week after. Event updated.
Devon Lee: quick poll — Thu 9am PT or Thu 8:30am PT? which is less painful for EU?
Maya Patel: lean 9am so NA mornings stay sane. ok if folks prefer 8:30 speak now.
Kevin O'Neill: 9am is fine.
Samir Khan: 9am works.
Maya Patel: cool. I'll mark this as pilot for 3 weeks and re-evaluate. If anyone has conflicts ping me or update calendar. Thanks all :v:
Devon Lee: thanks — appreciate the shorter agenda. I'll surface any sticky bugs before T-30m.
triage-bot: reminder will post at 8:30am PT on Thu (T-30m) with top issues.
Maya Patel: tagging @here for visibility this week.
